When to see theme pandals without the crush

  • Shashti evening or Saptami afternoon — lights are on, crowds have not peaked yet.
  • Early on Ashtami morning — many people are at anjali in their local para.
  • Avoid Navami night for the biggest names unless you enjoy the crowd itself.

Photography tips

  • Go just after dusk for the best mix of sky and lighting.
  • Shoot facades from across the road; inside, focus on details like the pratima’s eyes and ornaments.
  • Respect queue volunteers — many pandals do not allow stopping inside the sanctum.

Frequently asked questions

Which is the best theme pandal in Siliguri in 2026?

The list on this page ranks theme pandals by their 2026 pandal score. The top names change as reviews come in, so the list updates automatically.

How long should I spend at a theme pandal?

Plan 40–50 minutes for the biggest theme pandals, including the queue. Smaller theme pujas take about 30 minutes.

Are theme pandals in Siliguri open in the afternoon?

Most are open from the afternoon, but lighting effects are best after dusk. Afternoon visits usually have shorter queues.

Can I see several theme pandals in one evening?

Yes, if you stay within one zone. Use the zone-wise pandal map or the route planner with the Top Themes goal.
